title: India is honored to host the First BIMSTEC Home Ministers’ Meeting in New Delhi, says Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah
subtitle:
This historic meeting underscores our shared resolve to combat terrorism, transnational organized crime, narcotics radicalization, trafficking, illicit financial flows, and cyber threats
Through decisive coordination, we remain committed to building a safer, stronger, and more secure BIMSTEC region
Union Home Minister extends warm welcome to the Home Ministers and member state delegations
body_text:
Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah today said that India is honored to host the First BIMSTEC Home Ministers’ Meeting scheduled to be held in New Delhi on 13 October 2026.
In a post on X, Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah said, “India is honored to host the First BIMSTEC Home Ministers’ Meeting in New Delhi on 13 October 2026. I extend a warm welcome to the Hon’ble Home Ministers and member state delegations. This historic meeting underscores our shared resolve to combat terrorism, transnational organized crime, narcotics radicalization, trafficking, illicit financial flows, and cyber threats. Through decisive coordination, we remain committed to building a safer, stronger, and more secure BIMSTEC region.”
